tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Pinnacle Retail Group** is a mid-size retail company currently operating several brick-and-mortar stores across the region. They manage their own on-premises data centers, which host their inventory management systems, point-of-sale (POS) software, and a legacy customer loyalty database.

**Current Environment:**
- All infrastructure is managed in-house.
- Server hardware is aging and requires frequent maintenance.
- Scaling for holiday sales requires purchasing and installing temporary hardware months in advance.

tabs.title: Business Goals
tabs.content:
Pinnacle Retail wants to migrate to Azure to achieve the following:
- **Agility**: Rapidly deploy new storefronts for pop-up events.
- **Scalability**: Automatically handle traffic spikes during sales events without manual intervention.
- **Cost Efficiency**: Shift from a capital expenditure (CapEx) model to an operational expenditure (OpEx) model.
- **Disaster Recovery**: Ensure business continuity in case of a local data center failure.
